subject: ONE plump emperor penguin in a red knitted scarf, two identical green banknotes tucked in his belly fold, never held in one pose
second_characters: TWO greedy seagulls and hurrying shoppers crossing the lens in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE chunky chrome currency exchange machine with a banknote slot, a coin chute and a plain blue screen; gold coins

environment: a busy snowy city street at noon, shop windows, garlands, shoppers both ways, no empty ground
lighting: bright sunny winter noon, hard daylight; at 2.18 the machine screen flashes from blue to red
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the penguin fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, his face never under a quarter of it. He never stands still: hopping round the machine, flippers flapping, belly bouncing, feet stamping. Seagulls, shoppers, snow and coins tear across the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, speech beats too. The camera sways close, never parks, new shot size every beat. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: flat low male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.38, then the machine and seagulls carry it
audio.lip_sync: the penguin himself speaks, beak opening on every syllable, brows and jaw alive
audio.pronunciation: PER-va-ya ob-me-NYA-las. fta-RA-ya, VI-di-mo, na-SHLA svoy KURS v MI-nus

timeline.a: chest-up, beak working, he slaps the first green banknote into the slot, coins gush from the chute into his belly fold, a seagull whipping low across the lens
he hops round and slaps the identical second green banknote into the slot, a shopper across the lens
the screen flashes red, every coin rips out of his belly fold back up the chute and he is yanked against the machine, coins whipping across the lens
waist-up, facing the lens, beak working, he yanks his empty belly fold inside out with both flippers, the seagulls flapping low across the lens
waist-up, facing the lens, beak working, he hammers the machine with both flippers, belly bouncing, a shopper hurrying across the lens
the slot snags his scarf end and he spins round as it unwinds off his neck, a seagull tearing across the lens
he heaves the scarf back, leaning his whole body away, snow whipping across the lens
the scarf zips into the slot, his neck bare, he shakes out every feather, snow across the lens
the machine spits ONE tiny coin that bounces off his head, both seagulls swooping across the lens
he snatches the tiny coin from under a seagull's beak and swings it up to his eye
he stuffs it into his empty belly fold and pats it twice, shoppers sweeping across the lens
he turns his face to the lens with a flat stare and blinks once, his neck bare, a seagull bursting across the lens

must_appear: 0.00 the penguin in his red scarf, coins gushing; 1.48 the identical second green banknote; 2.18 red screen, coins flying back up the chute; 6.75 bare neck; 9.50 his flat stare at the lens
